fact: ACRA explains who needs to register a business and sets out additional rules for foreigners, including local-residency requirements and the use of a corporate service provider in certain cases.
source: Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA) — Registering a business

fact: ACRA places business structure before name selection and registration, and notes that the structure affects liability, cost and potential growth.
source: Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA) — Registering a business

fact: ACRA says a proposed name must be checked against existing and reserved names and may require referral approval depending on the name.
source: Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA) — Registering a business

fact: ACRA states that an approved business name can be reserved for up to 120 days and that the registration must be aligned with the reserved entity type.
source: Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA) — Registering a business

fact: ACRA requires the applicant to select the most relevant Singapore Standard Industrial Classification (SSIC) code when applying for a business name.
source: Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA) — Registering a business

fact: ACRA’s current Bizfile guide says a business name must be reserved before registering a local company, and the person who reserved the name can register it subject to the published rules.
source: Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA) — Registering a business

fact: ACRA’s guidance requires a business address and distinguishes the rules that can apply to home-based activities; a P.O. Box cannot be used as the main business address.
source: Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA) — Registering a business

fact: A source-first registration file should align identity, name, structure, activity, address and the applicant’s filing authority before the Bizfile submission.
source: Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA) — Registering a business

fact: ACRA maintains a dedicated post-registration guide because incorporation or registration is followed by additional statutory and administrative requirements.
source: Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA) — Registering a business

fact: For overseas founders, start with ACRA’s eligibility and foreigner rules, then separate business-registration requirements from immigration or work-pass requirements.
source: Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA) — Registering a business
